heading: REGIONAL REGULATION OF SUKAMARA REGENCY
CHAPTER I
text:
BAB I

KETENTUAN UMUM

Pasal 1

Dalam Peraturan Daerah yang dimaksud dengan:
1. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Sukamara.
2. Pemerintah Daerah adalah adalah Bupati sebagai unsur  penyelenggara Pemerintah Daerah yang memimpin pelaksanaan  urusan pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenangan daerah otonom.
3. Bupati adalah Bupati Sukamara.
4. Perangkat Daerah yang selanjutnya disingkat PD adalah  Perangkat Daerah di lingkungan Pemerintah Kabupaten  Sukamara.
5. Pemberdayaan Perempuan adalah upaya pemampuan perempuan  untuk memperoleh akses dan kontrol terhadap sumber daya  ekonomi, politik dan budaya agar perempuan dapat mengatur diri  dan meningkatkan rasa percaya diri untuk mampu berperan dan  berpartisipasi aktif dalam memecahkan masalah, sehingga  mampu membangun kemampuan dan konsep diri.
6. Perlindungan Perempuan adalah segala upaya untuk menjamin  dan melindungi hak perempuan agar dapat hidup sehat dan  berpartisipasi sacara optimal sesuai dengan harkat dan martabat  kemanusiaan serta mendapat perlindungan dari keterlantaran,  kekerasan dan diskriminasi baik berupa perlindungan preventif,  represif maupun postremedial (bantuan dan pengobatan).
7. Perlindungan Anak adalah segala kegiatan untuk menjamin dan  melindungi anak dan haknya agar dapat hidup, tumbuh,  berkembang dan berpartisipasi secara optimal sesuai dengan  harkat dan martabat kemanusiaan, serta mendapat perlindungan dari keterlantaran, kekerasan dan diskriminasi.
8. Anak adalah seseorang yang belum berusia 18 (delapan belas)  tahun, termasuk anak yang masih dalam kandungan dan belum  menikah.
9. Pencegahan adalah upaya langsung yang dilakukan oleh  Pemerintah Daerah, masyarakat dan orang tua dan/atau keluarga  untuk mencegah terjadinya pelanggaran hak perempuan dan anak.
10. Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan yang berakibat atau dapat mengakibatkan kesengsaraan atau penderitaan baik fisik,  seksual, ekonomi, sosial, dan psikis terhadap korban.
11. Forum anak adalah wadah partisipasi anak yang dibentuk  dengan tujuan memfasilitasi keterlibatan anak dalam proses  pengambilan keputusan dan menikmati perubahan yang  berkenaan dengan hidup mereka baik secara langsung maupun  tidak langsung, yang dilaksanakan dengan persetujuan dan  kemauan semua anak berdasarkan kesadaran dan pemahaman,  sesuai dengan usia dan tingkat kematangan berfikir.
12. Kabupaten Layak Anak adalah yang selanjutnya disingkat KLA  adalah Kabupaten yang mempunyai sistem pembangunan  berbasis hak anak melalui pengintegrasian komitmen dan sumber  daya pemerintah, masyarakat dan dunia usaha yang terencana  secara menyeluruh dan berkelanjutan dalam kebijakan, program  dan kegiatan untuk menjamin terpenuhinya hak anak.
13. Anak terlantar adalah anak yang tidak terpenuhi kebutuhannya  secara wajar, baik fisik, mental, spiritual maupun sosial.
14. Kesejahteraan sosial adalah kondisi terpenuhinya kebutuhan  material, spiritual dan sosial warga negara agar dapat hidup layak  dan mampu mengembangkan diri sehingga dapat melaksanakan  fungsi sosialnya.
15. Pengarusutamaan Gender yang selanjutnya disingkat PUG adalah  strategi yang dibangun untuk mengintegrasikan gender menjadi  satu dimensi integral dari perencanaan, penyusunan,  pelaksanaan, pemantauan dan evaluasi atas kebijakan program  pembangunan nasional.
16. Masyarakat adalah perorangan, keluarga, kelompok dan  organisasi sosial dan/atau organisasi kemasyarakatan.
17. Perempuan korban kekerasan adalah perempuan yang mengalami  tindakan yang mengakibatkan kesengsaraan atau penderitaan  secara fisik, seksual atau psikologis termasuk ancaman tindakan  tetrtentu, pemaksaan atau perampasan kemerdekaan secara  sewenang-wenang baik yang terjadi di ranah publik atau dalam  kehidupan pribadi.
18. Anak korban kekerasan adalah anak yang mengalami tindakan  yang mengakibatkan kesengsaraan atau penderitaan secara fisik,  mental, seksual, psikologis atau penelantaran yang mengancam  nyawa, badan dan merendahkan martabat kemanusiaan.
19. Perdagangan orang adalah tindakan perekrutan, pengangkutan, penampungan, pengiriman, pemindahan atau penerimaan  seseorang dengan ancaman kekerasan, penggunaan kekerasan,  penculikan, penyekapan, pemalsuan, penipuan, penyalahgunaan  kekuasaan atau posisi rentan, penjeratan uang atau memberi  bayaran atau manfaat, sehingga memperoleh persetujuan dari  orang yang memegang kendali atas orang lain tersebut, baik yang  dilakukan di dalam Negara maupun diluar Negara.
20. Penanganan Pengaduan adalah serangkaian tindakan yang  dilakukan oleh penyelenggara layanan terpadu untuk menindaklanjuti laporan adanya tindak kekerasan terhadap  perempuan dan anak, yang diajukan korban, keluarga atau  masyarakat.
21. Rehabilitasi Sosial adalah pelayanan yang ditujukan untuk  memulihkan dan mengembangkan kemampuan seseorang yang  mengalami disfungsi sosial agar dapat melaksanakan fungsi  sosialnya secara wajar.
22. Penegakan hukum adalah tindakan aparat yang diberi  kewenangan oleh negara untuk melaksanakan peraturan  perundang-undangan.
23. Focal point PUG adalah operator OPD yang mempunyai  kemampuan untuk melakukan pengarusutamaan gender di Unit kerjanya masing-masing.
24. Bantuan hukum adalah jasa hukum yang diberikan oleh  pendamping hukum dan advokat untuk melakukan proses  bantuan saksi dan/atau korban kekerasan terhadap perempuan  dan anak yang sensitif gender.
25. Pemulangan adalah upaya mengembalikan perempuan dan anak  korban kekerasan dari luar negeri ke titik debarkasi/entry point atau Daerah penerima ke daerah asal.
26. Reintegrasi sosial adalah upaya penyatuan kembali korban  dengan pihak keluarga, keluarga pengganti atau masyarakat yang  dapat memberikan perlindungan dan pemenuhan kebutuhan bagi  korban.
27. Rumah aman adalah sebuah tempat bernaung sementara yang  bertujuan untuk memberikan rasa aman kepada korban kekerasan.
28. Rumah singgah adalah wadah pembinaan dan pelayanan  kesejahteraan anak jalanan sehingga dapat tumbuh kembang wajar.
29. Bimbingan rohani adalah usaha pemulihan kejiwaan dan  sistematis terhadap perbedaan-perbedaan perempuan dan laki laki di dalam masyarakat yang disertai upaya menghapus  hambatan-hambatan struktural dan kultural dalam mencapai  kesetaraan gender.
30. Responsif Gender adalah perhatian yang konsisten dan sistematis  terhadap perbedaan perempuan dan laki-laki di dalam  masyarakat yang disertai upaya menghapus hambatan struktural  dan kultural dalam mencapai kesetaraan gender.
31. Kepekaan Gender atau kesadaran Gender adalah kemampuan  untuk menemu kenali kesenjangan hubungan kekuasaan antara  perempuan dan laki-laki di dalam keluarga dan di dalam  komunitas, dampak pembagian kerja berdasarkan gender  terhadap perempuan dan laki-laki dan pengalaman  permasalahan, kebutuhan, kepentingan dan aspirasi perempuan  dan laki-laki adalah berbeda.
32. Penyelenggara pelayanan publik adalah setiap institusi  penyelenggara negara, korporasi, lembaga independen yang  dibentuk berdasarkan undang-undang untuk kegiatan pelayanan  publik dan badan hukum lain yang dibentuk semata-mata untuk  kegiatan pelayanan publik.
33. Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan anak  yang selanjutnya disingkat P2TP2A adalah Pusat pelayanan yang  terintegrasi dalam upaya pemberdayaan perempuan dan anak  dari berbagai bidang pembangunan serta perlindungan  perempuan dan anak dari berbagai jenis diskriminasi dan tindak  kekerasan, termasuk perdagangan orang yang dibentuk oleh  pemerintah atau berbasis masyarakat, yang meliputi: pusat  rujukan, pusat konsultasi usaha, pusat konsultasi kesehatan  reproduksi, pusat krisis terpadu (PKT), pusat pemulihan trauma  (trauma center), pusat penanganan krisis perempuan (women  crisis center), pusat pelatihan, pusat informasi ilmu pengetahuan  dan tehnologi (PIPTEK), rumah aman (shelter), rumah singgah,  telepon sahabat anak (TESSA) 129 atau bentuk lainnya.
34. Organisasi kemasyarakatan adalah organisasi yang didirikan dan  dibentuk oleh masyarakat secara sukarela berdasarkan  kesamaan aspirasi kehendak, kebutuhan, kepentingan dan  tujuan untuk berpartisipasi dalam pembangunan demi  tercapainya tujuan Negara Kesatuan Republik Indonesia yang  berdasarkan Pancasila.
35. Orang Tua adalah ayah dan/atau ibu kandung atau ayah  dan/ibu tiri atau ayah dan/atau ibu angkat.
36. Keluarga adalah unit terkecil dalam masyarakat yang terdiri dari  suami dan istri atau suami, istri dan anaknya, atau ayah dan  anaknya, atau ibu dan anaknya, atau keluarga sedarah dalam  garis lurus ke atas atau kebawah sampai dengan derajat ketiga.
37. Adat istiadat adalah tata nilai kearifan lokal yang berlaku dan  masih diterapkan secara turun temurun dari generasi ke generasi  dalam lingkungan masyarakat.
38. Gugus Tugas Kabupaten adalah lembaga koordinasi di tingkat  kabupaten yang mengkoordinasikan upaya kebijakan program  dan kegiatan untuk mewujudkan kabupaten layak anak.
39. Rencana aksi adalah Daerah Pembangunan Kabupaten layak  Anak adalah dokumen yang memuat kebijakan program dan  kegiatan untuk mewujudkan Kabupaten layak Anak.
translated_text:
CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, the following terms shall mean:
1. Region is Sukamara Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the Regional Government administrator who leads the implementation of governmental affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Sukamara.
4. Regional Apparatus hereinafter abbreviated as PD is the Regional Apparatus within the Sukamara Regency Government.
5. Women's Empowerment is an effort to enable women to obtain access and control over economic, political and cultural resources so that women can manage themselves and increase self-confidence to be able to play a role and actively participate in solving problems, so as to be able to build capacity and self-concept.
6. Women's Protection is all efforts to guarantee and protect women's rights so that they can live healthily and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from neglect, violence and discrimination whether in the form of preventive, repressive or post-remedial protection (assistance and treatment).
7. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from neglect, violence and discrimination.
8. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including children who are still in the womb and are not married.
9. Prevention is a direct effort carried out by the Regional Government, community and parents and/or family to prevent violations of the rights of women and children.
10. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological to the victim.
11. Children's forum is a platform for children's participation formed with the aim of facilitating children's involvement in the decision-making process and enjoying changes relating to their lives either directly or indirectly, which is carried out with the consent and will of all children based on awareness and understanding, in accordance with age and level of maturity of thinking.
12. Child-Friendly Regency hereinafter abbreviated as KLA is a Regency that has a child rights-based development system through the integration of commitment and resources of government, community and business world that is planned comprehensively and sustainably in policies, programs and activities to ensure the fulfillment of children's rights.
13. Neglected child is a child whose needs are not properly fulfilled, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social.
14. Social welfare is a condition of fulfillment of material, spiritual and social needs of citizens so that they can live properly and are able to develop themselves so that they can carry out their social functions.
15. Gender Mainstreaming hereinafter abbreviated as PUG is a strategy built to integrate gender into an integral dimension of planning, formulation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of national development program policies.
16. Community is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.
17. Women victims of violence are women who experience actions that result in misery or suffering physically, sexually or psychologically including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom arbitrarily whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life.
18. Child victims of violence are children who experience actions that result in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically or neglect that threatens life, body and degrades human dignity.
19. Human trafficking is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer or receipt of a person by threat of violence, use of violence, kidnapping, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the Country or outside the Country.
20. Complaint Handling is a series of actions carried out by integrated service providers to follow up on reports of acts of violence against women and children, submitted by victims, families or the community.
21. Social Rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions normally.
22. Law enforcement is the action of officials authorized by the state to implement laws and regulations.
23. PUG focal point is an OPD operator who has the ability to carry out gender mainstreaming in their respective work units.
24. Legal aid is legal services provided by legal assistants and advocates to carry out the process of assisting witnesses and/or victims of violence against women and children that is gender sensitive.
25. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence from abroad to the debarkation point/entry point or from the receiving Region to the region of origin.
26. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
27. Safe house is a temporary shelter that aims to provide a sense of security to victims of violence.
28. Shelter home is a forum for guidance and welfare services for street children so that they can grow and develop normally.
29. Spiritual guidance is an effort to restore the soul and systematic towards differences between women and men in society accompanied by efforts to eliminate structural and cultural barriers in achieving gender equality.
30. Gender Responsive is consistent and systematic attention to the differences between women and men in society accompanied by efforts to eliminate structural and cultural barriers in achieving gender equality.
31. Gender Sensitivity or Gender Awareness is the ability to identify gaps in power relations between women and men in the family and in the community, the impact of gender-based division of labor on women and men and the experience that problems, needs, interests and aspirations of women and men are different.
32. Public service provider is every state organizing institution, corporation, independent institution formed based on law for public service activities and other legal entities formed solely for public service activities.
33. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Children hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service center in efforts to empower women and children from various fields of development as well as protection of women and children from various types of discrimination and acts of violence, including trafficking in persons formed by the government or community-based, which includes: referral centers, business consultation centers, reproductive health consultation centers, integrated crisis centers (PKT), trauma recovery centers (trauma centers), women's crisis handling centers (women crisis centers), training centers, science and technology information centers (PIPTEK), safe houses (shelters), shelter homes, children's friend telephone (TESSA) 129 or other forms.
34. Community organization is an organization established and formed by the community voluntarily based on common aspirations, will, needs, interests and goals to participate in development for the achievement of the goals of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia based on Pancasila.
35. Parents are biological father and/or mother or stepfather and/or stepmother or adoptive father and/or mother.
36. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife or husband, wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
37. Customs are local wisdom values that apply and are still applied from generation to generation in the community environment.
38. Regency Task Force is a coordination body at the regency level that coordinates policy program and activity efforts to realize a child-friendly regency.
39. Action plan is the Regional Development of Child-Friendly Regency is a document containing policies, programs and activities to realize a Child-Friendly Regency.

heading: Article 2
text:
Pasal 2

Sistem Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak  bertujuan untuk:
a. meningkatkan kualitas hidup perempuan, anak, dan kualitas  keluarga;
b. meningkatkan kapasitas kelembagaan pemberdayaan perempuan  dan perlindungan anak di Kabupaten Sukamara, termasuk  pengembangan sistem data gender dan anak; dan
c. memberikan perlindungan hak perempuan dan pemenuhan hak  anak termasuk perlindungan khusus bagi anak dari berbagai  bentuk kekerasan dan perlakuan diskriminatif lainnya.
translated_text:
Article 2

The Women's Empowerment and Child Protection System aims to:
a. improve the quality of life of women, children, and the quality of families;
b. enhance the institutional capacity of women's empowerment and child protection in Sukamara Regency, including the development of gender and child data systems; and
c. provide protection of women's rights and fulfillment of children's rights including special protection for children from various forms of violence and other discriminatory treatment.

heading: CHAPTER II
text:
BAB II

HAK PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK

Pasal 3

Setiap perempuan dan anak memiliki hak dasar sebagai manusia yang  wajib dilindungi, dimajukan, ditegakkan dan dipenuhi sesuai  ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER II

RIGHTS OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

Article 3

Every woman and child has basic rights as a human being that must be protected, promoted, upheld and fulfilled in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

translated_text:
Article 11

1. In an effort to accelerate the institutionalization of Gender Mainstreaming, a Gender Mainstreaming working group is established in all Regional Apparatus.
2. Members of the Gender Mainstreaming working group are all Heads of Regional Apparatus chaired by the Head of the Regional Apparatus that administers government affairs in the field of regional development planning as chair of the gender mainstreaming working group and the head of the Regional Apparatus that administers government affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection as head of the Secretariat of the Gender Mainstreaming Working Group.
3. The establishment of the Gender Mainstreaming working group as referred to in paragraph (1) is stipulated by Regent's Decree.

heading: Article 23
Article 24
text:
Pasal 24

1. Pengaduan tindak kekerasan terhadap perempuan dapat dilakukan oleh pelapor yang terdiri atas korban keluarga,  masyarakat dan/atau organisasi kemasyarakatan di bidang  perlindungan perempuan dan anak.
2. Pelaporan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat melakukan  pengaduan:
a. secara langsung;
b. melalui telepon; dan/atauc. melalui surat.
3. Selain penanganan pengaduan yang disampaikan oleh pelapor, petugas pada lembaga pelayanan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam  Pasal 23, juga berwenang melakukan penanganan korban tindak  kekerasan terhadap perempuan yang diperoleh melalui informasi  lainnya.
4. Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai tata cara pelayanan penanganan  pengaduan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dan ayat (2)  diatur dalam Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 24

1. Complaints of acts of violence against women may be made by reporters consisting of victims, family, community and/or community organizations in the field of protection of women and children.
2. Reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) may file complaints:
a. directly;
b. by telephone; and/orc. by letter.
3. In addition to handling complaints submitted by reporters, officers at service institutions as referred to in Article 23, are also authorized to handle victims of acts of violence against women obtained through other information.
4. Further provisions regarding procedures for complaint handling services as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) shall be regulated in a Regent Regulation.

heading: Paragraph 3
text:
Paragraf 3

Rehabilitasi Kesehatan
translated_text:
Paragraph 3

Health Rehabilitation

heading: Article 25
text:
Pasal 25

1. Rehabilitasi Kesehatan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 22 huruf b, merupakan upaya yang meliputi aspek:
a. promotif;
b. preventif;
c. kuratif; dan
d. rehabilitatif.
2. Rehabilitasi kesehatan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  dilakukan secara komprehensif, dapat diakses 24 (dua puluh empat) jam di RSUD dan dilakukan sesuai dengan standar  pelayanan kesehatan.
3. Perempuan korban tindak kekerasan memiliki hak terhadap  pelayanan kesehatan secara bebas biaya baik biaya medis,  medikolegal dan visum.
4. Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai tata cara pelaksanaan  Rehabilitasi kesehatan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3)  diatur dalam Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 25

1. Health Rehabilitation as referred to in Article 22 letter b, constitutes efforts that include aspects of:
a. promotive;
b. preventive;
c. curative; and
d. rehabilitative.
2. Health rehabilitation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted comprehensively, accessible 24 (twenty-four) hours at the Regional General Hospital and conducted in accordance with health service standards.
3. Women victims of acts of violence have the right to health services free of charge for both medical costs, medicolegal and visum.
4. Further provisions regarding procedures for implementation of health rehabilitation as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be regulated in a Regent Regulation.

heading: Paragraph 4
text:
Paragraf 4

Rehabilitasi Sosial
translated_text:
Paragraph 4

Social Rehabilitation

heading: Article 26
text:
Pasal 26

1. Rehabilitasi sosial sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 22  huruf c, ditujukan untuk memulihkan dan mengembangkan  kemampuan terhadap perempuan korban tindak kekerasan yang  mengalami disfungsi sosial untuk dapat melaksanakan fungsi  sosialnya dalam masyarakat secara wajar.
2. Rehabilitasi sosial sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi  pelayanan:
a. konseling;
b. penyediaan rumah aman; dan
c. bimbingan rohani.
3. Penyelenggaraan pelayanan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2)  diselenggarakan oleh:
a. PD yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang  sosial;
b. PD yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang  pemberdayaan perempuan dana anak, serta dapat  berkerja sama dengan pusat pelayanan terpadu women crisis  center atau organisasi kemasyarakatan di bidang sosial yang  telah ada; atau.
c. instansi dan/atau organisasi keagamaan.
translated_text:
Article 26

1. Social rehabilitation as referred to in Article 22 letter c, is aimed at restoring and developing the capacity of women victims of acts of violence who experience social dysfunction to be able to carry out their social functions in society properly.
2. Social rehabilitation as referred to in paragraph (1) includes services:
a. counseling;
b. provision of safe houses; and
c. spiritual guidance.
3. Implementation of services as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be organized by:
a. Regional Apparatus that organizes government affairs in the social field;
b. Regional Apparatus that organizes government affairs in the field of women and child empowerment, and may cooperate with integrated service centers women crisis center or community organizations in the social field that already exist; or.
c. religious institutions and/or organizations.

heading: Article 27
Article 28
text:
Pasal 28

1. Pemerintah Daerah dapat menyediakan rumah aman terhadap perempuan korban tindak kekerasan.
2. Pelayanan penyediaan rumah aman sebagaimana dimaksud  dalam Pasal 26 ayat (2) huruf b bertujuan untuk melindungi perempuan korban tindak kekerasan dari intimidasi pelaku atau  pihak lain.
3. Lokasi rumah aman sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) harus  dirahasiakan.
4. Kriteria perempuan korban tindak kekerasan yang memerlukan  rumah aman meliputi:
a. terancam jiwanya;
b. mendapatkan penolakan dari keluarga atau masyarakat;
c. memerlukan pelayanan intensif namun rumah tinggalnya  relatif jauh; dan/atau
d. terlantar jika tidak ditempatkan dalam rumah aman.
5. Penyelenggaraan pelayanan rumah aman dilakukan oleh petugas  rehabilitasi sosial yang memiliki kepekaan gender atau kesadaran  gender, terdiri atas:
a. pekerja sosial/relawan;
b. petugas keamanan; dan/atau
c. tokoh masyarakat.
6. Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai penyelenggaraan pelayanan  rumah aman diatur dalam Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 28

1. The Regional Government may provide safe houses for women victims of acts of violence.
2. Provision of safe house services as referred to in Article 26 paragraph (2) letter b aims to protect women victims of acts of violence from intimidation by perpetrators or other parties.
3. The location of the safe house as referred to in paragraph (1) must be kept confidential.
4. Criteria for women victims of acts of violence who require safe houses include:
a. life is threatened;
b. receiving rejection from family or community;
c. requiring intensive services but their residence is relatively far; and/or
d. abandoned if not placed in a safe house.
5. Implementation of safe house services shall be conducted by social rehabilitation officers who have gender sensitivity or gender awareness, consisting of:
a. social workers/volunteers;
b. security officers; and/or
c. community leaders.
6. Further provisions regarding implementation of safe house services shall be regulated in a Regent Regulation.

heading: Article 29
text:
Pasal 29

1. Bimbingan rohani sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 26  ayat (2) huruf c bertujuan untuk pemulihan kejiwaan.
2. Bimbingan rohani sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan berdasarkan prinsip:
a. tidak memaksakan agama atau keyakinan apapun; dan
b. menyerahkan putusan akhir ditangan korban.
3. Bimbingan rohani dilakukan oleh petugas bimbingan rohani.
4. Petugas bimbingan rohani sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) terdiri dari konsultan Badan Penasehat, Pembinaan dan  Pelestarian Perkawinan, Petugas kantor Urusan agama, pemuka agama, yang memiliki kepekaan gender atau kesadaran gender.
translated_text:
Article 29

1. Spiritual guidance as referred to in Article 26 paragraph (2) letter c aims for psychological recovery.
2. Spiritual guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented based on the principles of:
a. not imposing any religion or belief; and
b. leaving the final decision in the hands of the victim.
3. Spiritual guidance shall be conducted by spiritual guidance officers.
4. Spiritual guidance officers as referred to in paragraph (3) consist of consultants from the Advisory Board, Guidance and Preservation of Marriage, Officers of the Religious Affairs Office, religious leaders, who have gender sensitivity or gender awareness.

heading: Paragraph 5
text:
Paragraf 5

Penegakan dan Bantuan Hukum
translated_text:
Paragraph 5

Law Enforcement and Legal Aid

heading: Article 30
text:
Pasal 30

1. Pelayanan penegakan dan bantuan hukum sebagaimana  dimaksud dalam pasal 22 huruf d merupakan tindakan aparat  penegak hukum untuk melaksanakan peraturan  perundang-undangan dalam rangka menangani kasus tindak  kekerasan terhadap perempuan terutama untuk memberikan sanksi terhadap pelaku dan memberikan perlindungan bagi saksi  dan/atau korban.
2. Pelayanan penegakan dan bantuan hukum sebagaimana  dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan dengan mengutamakan  kepentingan terbaik bagi korban.
translated_text:
Article 30

1. Law enforcement and legal aid services as referred to in article 22 letter d constitute actions of law enforcement officials to implement laws and regulations in order to handle cases of acts of violence against women especially to provide sanctions against perpetrators and provide protection for witnesses and/or victims.
2. Law enforcement and legal aid services as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted by prioritizing the best interests of the victim.

heading: Article 31
Paragraph 6
text:
Paragraf 6

Pemulangan dan Reintregasi Sosial
translated_text:
Paragraph 6

Repatriation and Social Reintegration

heading: Article 32
text:
Pasal 32

1. Pemulangan ditujukan untuk mengembalikan perempuan korban  tindak kekerasan ke Daerah asalnya.
2. Pemulangan perempuan korban tindak kekerasan disertai upaya  reintegrasi sosial.
translated_text:
Article 32

1. Repatriation is aimed at returning women victims of acts of violence to their region of origin.
2. Repatriation of women victims of acts of violence shall be accompanied by social reintegration efforts.

heading: Article 33
text:
Pasal 33

1. Reintegrasi sosial sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 32 ayat (2)  dilakukan dalam rangka penyatuan kembali perempuan korban  tindak kekerasan dengan pihak keluarga pengganti, atau  masyarakat yang dapat memberikan perlindungan dan  pemenuhan kebutuhan bagi korban.
2. Reintegrasi sosial ditujukan agar:
a. perempuan korban tindak kekerasan dapat meneruskan  kembali kehidupan sosialnya; dan
b. perempuan korban tindak kekerasan dapat memiliki  kehidupan yang layak.
3. Reintegrasi sosial sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan  setelah korban menerima pelayanan rehabilitasi sosial.
translated_text:
Article 33

1. Social reintegration as referred to in Article 32 paragraph (2) shall be conducted in order to reunite women victims of acts of violence with substitute family parties, or communities that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
2. Social reintegration is aimed so that:
a. women victims of acts of violence can resume their social life; and
b. women victims of acts of violence can have a decent life.
3. Social reintegration as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted after the victim receives social rehabilitation services.

heading: Article 34
text:
Pasal 34

Pemerintah Daerah melaksanakan pemulangam dan reintegrasi sosial  perempuan korban tindak kekerasan sesuai peraturan  perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 34

The Regional Government shall implement repatriation and social reintegration of women victims of acts of violence in accordance with laws and regulations.

heading: Part Four
text:
Bagian Keempat

Perlindungan ketenagakerjaan
translated_text:
Part Four

Employment Protection

heading: Article 35
text:
Pasal 35

1. Pengusaha yang memperkerjakan perempuan wajib menjaga  kesusilaan, keselamatan dan keamanan selama di tempat kerja.
2. Pengusaha wajib menempatkan pekerja perempuan di tempat  yang aman bagi kesehatan reproduksi perempuan.
3. Pengusaha wajib memenuhi hak pekerja perempuan untuk  mendapatkan upah sesuai ketentuan peraturan perundang undangan.
4. Pengusaha wajib menyediakan fasilitas khusus menyusui di  perusahaannya.
translated_text:
Article 35

1. Employers who employ women must maintain decency, safety and security while in the workplace.
2. Employers must place female workers in places that are safe for women's reproductive health.
3. Employers must fulfill the rights of female workers to receive wages in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.
4. Employers must provide special breastfeeding facilities in their companies.

heading: Article 36
text:
Pasal 36

1. Pekerja/buruh perempuan yang berumur kurang dari 18  (delapan belas) tahun dilarang dipekerjakan antara pukul 23.00  WIB sampai dengan 07.00 WIB.
2. Pengusaha dilarang mempekerjakan pekerja/buruh perempuan  hamil yang menurut keterangan dokter berbahaya bagi  kesehatan dan keselamatan kandungannya.
3. Pengusaha yang mempekerjakan pekerja/buruh antara pukul  23.00 WIB sampai dengan 07.00 WIB, wajib:a. memberikan makanan dan minuman bergizi; dan
b. menjaga kesusilaan dan keamanan selama di tempat kerja.
4. Pengusaha wajib menyediakan angkutan antar jemput bagi  pekerja/buruh perempuan yang berangkat dan pulang antara  pukul 23.00 WIB sampai dengan 05.00 WIB.
translated_text:
Article 36

1. Female workers/laborers who are less than 18 (eighteen) years old are prohibited from being employed between 23.00 WIB until 07.00 WIB.
2. Employers are prohibited from employing pregnant female workers/laborers who according to a doctor's statement are dangerous to the health and safety of their pregnancy.
3. Employers who employ workers/laborers between 23.00 WIB until 07.00 WIB, must:a. provide nutritious food and drinks; and
b. maintain decency and security while in the workplace.
4. Employers must provide shuttle transportation for female workers/laborers who depart and return between 23.00 WIB until 05.00 WIB.

heading: CHAPTER V
text:
BAB V

PENINGKATAN KUALITAS KELUARGA

Pasal 37

1. Dalam rangka meningkatkan kualitas keluarga, Pemerintah  Daerah bertanggung jawab:
a. melakukan upaya peningkatan kualitas keluarga utuk  mewujukan kesetaraan gender dan hak anak;
b. menyediakan layanan bagi keluarga dalam mewujudkan  kesetaraan gender dan hak anak; dan
c. menguatkan dan mengembangkan lembaga penyedia layanan peningkatan kualitas keluarga.
2. Tanggung jawab Pemerintah Daerah dalam upaya peningkatan  kualitas keluarga sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  dilaksanakan oleh PD sesuai dengan tugas dan fungsinya.
translated_text:
CHAPTER V

IMPROVEMENT OF FAMILY QUALITY

Article 37

1. In order to improve family quality, the Regional Government is responsible for:
a. making efforts to improve family quality to realize gender equality and children's rights;
b. providing services for families in realizing gender equality and children's rights; and
c. strengthening and developing institutions providing family quality improvement services.
2. The responsibility of the Regional Government in efforts to improve family quality as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by PD in accordance with their duties and functions.

heading: Article 38
Article 39
Article 40
Article 41
Article 42
Article 43
text:
Pasal 43

Komunikasi, informasi dan edukasi sebagaimana dimaksud dalam  Pasal 42 huruf a merupakan kegiatan komunikasi untuk  meningkatkan pengetahuan serta memperbaiki sikap dan perilaku  keluarga dan masyarakat dalam program kependudukan dan keluarga  berencana.
translated_text:
Article 43

Communication, information and education as referred to in Article 42 letter a is a communication activity to increase knowledge and improve the attitudes and behavior of families and communities in population and family planning programs.

heading: Article 44
CHAPTER VI
text:
BAB VI

PERLINDUNGAN ANAK

Pasal 45

1. PD dan instansi terkait wajib melakukan pengelolaan data gender  dan anak yang meliputi tahapan:
a. pengumpulan;
b. pengolahan;
c. analisa; dan
d. penyajian.
2. Pengumpulan data sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf a, dilakukan melalui survei, registrasi, statistik rutin instansi,  penelitian dengan menggunakan data sekunder, dan/atau cara lain sesuai dengan perkembangan ilmu pengetahuan dan  tehnologi.
3. Pengolahan data sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf b, dilakukan pada semua jenis data terpilah terkait gender dan  anak.
4. Analisis data sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf c, dilakukan dengan menggunakan metodologi pengolahan data  sesuai dengan kebutuhan.
5. Penyajian sebagaimana dimaksud ayat (1) huruf d dilakukan dengan menggunakan media cetak dan/atau media elektronik.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VI

CHILD PROTECTION

Article 45

1. PD and related agencies must carry out gender and child data management which includes stages:
a. collection;
b. processing;
c. analysis; and
d. presentation.
2. Data collection as referred to in paragraph (1) letter a, is carried out through surveys, registration, routine agency statistics, research using secondary data, and/or other methods in accordance with the development of science and technology.
3. Data processing as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b, is carried out on all types of disaggregated data related to gender and children.
4. Data analysis as referred to in paragraph (1) letter c, is carried out using data processing methodology in accordance with needs.
5. Presentation as referred to in paragraph (1) letter d is carried out using print media and/or electronic media.

heading: Article 46
text:
Pasal 46

1. PD yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintah di bidang  pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak berkewajiban  menyelenggarakan data gender dan anak.
2. Penyelenggaraan data gender dan anak sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan dengan berkoordinasi dengan Badan  Pusat Statistik dan Badan yang menyelenggarakan urusan  Pemerintahan di bidang Perencanaan Pembangunan Daerah.
translated_text:
Article 46

1. PD that administers government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is obliged to organize gender and child data.
2. The organization of gender and child data as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out in coordination with the Central Statistics Agency and the Agency that administers Government affairs in the field of Regional Development Planning.

heading: Article 47
text:
Pasal 47

1. Data Gender dan anak sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 45 ayat (1) menjadi bahan untuk rekapitulasi data oleh PD yang  menyelenggarakan Urusan Pemerintahan di bidang  pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak.
2. Hasil rekapitulasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  dilaporkan kepada Bupati setiap tahun berjalan dan di sebar luaskan kepada PD dan instansi terkait.
translated_text:
Article 47

1. Gender and child data as referred to in Article 45 paragraph (1) becomes material for data recapitulation by PD that administers Government Affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection.
2. The recapitulation results as referred to in paragraph (1) are reported to the Regent every current year and disseminated to PD and related agencies.

heading: CHAPTER VII
text:
BAB VII

PEMENUHAN HAK ANAK

Bagian Kesatu

Umum
translated_text:
CHAPTER VII

FULFILLMENT OF CHILDREN'S RIGHTS

Part One

General

heading: Article 48
Part Two
text:
Bagian Kedua

Pencatatan Kelahiran dan Pendidikan
translated_text:
Part Two

Birth Registration and Education

heading: Article 49
text:
Pasal 49

1. Pemerintah Daerah berkewajiban menyelenggarakan pencatatan  kelahiran anak dengan penerbitan akta kelahiran.
2. Akta kelahiran sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  diselenggarakan secara bebas biaya.
translated_text:
Article 49

1. The Regional Government is obligated to organize birth registration of children with the issuance of birth certificates.
2. Birth certificates as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be organized free of charge.

heading: Article 50
text:
Pasal 50

Pemerintah Daerah menjamin terselenggara program wajib belajar 12 (dua belas) tahun untuk anak berusia 7 (tujuh) sampai dengan 19 (sembilan belas) tahun.
translated_text:
Article 50

The Regional Government guarantees the implementation of a 12 (twelve) year compulsory education program for children aged 7 (seven) to 19 (nineteen) years.

heading: Article 51
text:
Pasal 51

1. Setiap penyelenggara satuan pendidikan wajib memberikan  kesempatan kepada anak untuk memperoleh layanan tanpa  diskriminasi.
2. Setiap penyelenggara satuan pendidikan dilarang mengeluarkan  anak dari lembaga pendidikan kecuali ada jaminan terhadap  keberlangsungan pendidikan anak.
3. Dalam hal anak korban tindak kekerasan mengalami putus  sekolah, penyelenggara satuan pendidikan wajib berkoordinasi  dengan instansi terkait.
translated_text:
Article 51

1. Every organizer of an educational unit is obligated to provide opportunities for children to obtain services without discrimination.
2. Every organizer of an educational unit is prohibited from expelling children from educational institutions unless there is a guarantee for the continuity of the child's education.
3. In the event that a child victim of violence experiences dropping out of school, the organizer of the educational unit is obligated to coordinate with related agencies.

heading: Article 52
text:
Pasal 52

1. Anak penyandang disabilitas dan anak berkebutuhan khusus di  berikan kesempatan yang sama untuk memperoleh layanan pendidikan formal, nonformal dan informal, termasuk pendidikan  inklusi.
2. Pemerintah daerah menyediakan tenaga pendidik bagi pendidikan inklusi pada setiap satuan pendidikan.
translated_text:
Article 52

1. Children with disabilities and children with special needs are given equal opportunities to obtain formal, non-formal and informal educational services, including inclusive education.
2. The regional government provides educators for inclusive education at every educational unit.

heading: Article 53
text:
Pasal 53

Anak yang berhadapan dengan hukum, anak mengalami kehamilan di  luar pernikahan dan/atau tidak diinginkan serta anak korban penularan HIV/AIDS dilindungi haknya guna memperoleh pendidikan.
translated_text:
Article 53

Children in conflict with the law, children experiencing pregnancy outside of marriage and/or unwanted pregnancy as well as child victims of HIV/AIDS transmission are protected in their rights to obtain education.

heading: Part Three
text:
Bagian Ketiga

Kesehatan dan Sosial
translated_text:
Part Three

Health and Social

heading: Article 54
text:
Pasal 54

1. Pemerintah Daerah wajib menyelenggarakan layanan kesehatan  yang komprehensif bagi anak, setiap anak memperoleh derajat kesehatan yang optimal sejak dalam kandungan.
2. Layanan kesehatan yang komprehensif sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (1) meliputi:
a. upaya promotif, preventif, kuratif dan rehabilitatif untuk  pelayanan dan kesehatan dasar; dan
b. pembebasan dari beban biaya bagi anak gizi buruk, anak  penyandang disabilitas, anak berkebutuhan khusus, anak  yang terinfeksi HIV/AIDS, pekerja anak, anak korban  penyalahgunaan narkotika, alkohol, psikotropika, dan zat  adiktif lainnya, anak yang menjadi korban kekerasan dan anak  korban perdagangan orang.
3. Pemerintah Daerah, masyarakat, keluarga dan orang tua wajib  mengusahakan agar anak yang lahir terhindar dari penyakit yang  mengancam kelangsungan hidup dan/atau menimbulkan  kecacatan.
translated_text:
Article 54

1. The Regional Government is obligated to organize comprehensive health services for children, so that every child obtains optimal health status from the womb.
2. Comprehensive health services as referred to in paragraph (1) include:
a. promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative efforts for basic health services and care; and
b. exemption from cost burdens for malnourished children, children with disabilities, children with special needs, children infected with HIV/AIDS, child workers, child victims of narcotics abuse, alcohol, psychotropics, and other addictive substances, children who are victims of violence and child victims of human trafficking.
3. The Regional Government, community, family and parents are obligated to ensure that children who are born are protected from diseases that threaten survival and/or cause disability.

heading: Article 55
Article 56
Article 57
text:
Pasal 57

1. Upaya kuratif pelayanan kesehatan dasar sebagaimana dimaksud  dalam pasal 54 ayat (2) huruf a, ditujukan untuk mencegah  penyakit lebih parah melalui pengobatan.
2. Pengobatan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), secara bebas  biaya bagi anak yang berasal dari keluarga kurang mampu.
translated_text:
Article 57

1. Curative efforts for basic health services as referred to in Article 54 paragraph (2) letter a, are aimed at preventing disease from becoming more severe through treatment.
2. Treatment as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be free of charge for children from underprivileged families.

heading: Article 58
text:
Pasal 58

1. Upaya rehabilitatif pelayanan kesehatan dasar sebagaimana  dimaksud dalam Pasal 54 ayat (2) huruf a, ditujukan untuk memelihara dan memulihkan kondisi setelah sakit.
2. Upaya rehabilitatif sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), dilakukan melalui pemeriksaan kesehatan secara berkala.
translated_text:
Article 58

1. Rehabilitative efforts for basic health services as referred to in Article 54 paragraph (2) letter a, are aimed at maintaining and restoring conditions after illness.
2. Rehabilitative efforts as referred to in paragraph (1), are carried out through periodic health examinations.

heading: Article 59
Part Four
text:
Bagian Keempat

Ketenagakerjaan
translated_text:
Part Four

Employment

heading: Article 60
text:
Pasal 60

Pemerintah daerah melakukan pengawasan berkala pada setiap  orang/ badan yang mempekerjakan anak dalam upaya perlindungan  terhadap pekerja anak.
translated_text:
Article 60

The regional government conducts periodic supervision of every person/entity that employs children in efforts to protect child workers.

heading: Article 61
Article 62
text:
Pasal 62

Dalam hal anak dipekerjakan bersama dengan tenaga kerja dewasa,  maka tempat kerja anak harus dipisahkan dari tempat kerja dewasa.
translated_text:
Article 62

In the event that children are employed together with adult workers, the workplace for children must be separated from the workplace for adults.

heading: Article 63
text:
Pasal 63

1. Setiap orang/badan dilarang mempekerjakan dan melibatkan  anak pada pekerjaan yang terburuk.
2. Pekerjaan yang terburuk yang dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi:
a. segala pekerjaan dalam bentuk perbudakan atau sejenisnya;
b. segala pekerjaan yang memanfaatkan, menyediakan atau menawarkan anak untuk pelacuran, produksi pornografi,  pertunjukkan porno, atau perjudian;
c. segala pekerjaan yang memanfaatkan, menyediakan atau  melibatkan anak untuk produksi dan perdagangan minuman  keras, narkotika, psikotropika, dan zat adiktif lainnya;  dan/atau
d. semua pekerjaan yang membahayakan kesehatan,  keselamatan atau moral anak.
translated_text:
Article 63

1. Every person/entity is prohibited from employing and involving children in the worst forms of work.
2. The worst forms of work referred to in paragraph (1) include:
a. all work in the form of slavery or the like;
b. all work that utilizes, provides or offers children for prostitution, pornography production, pornographic performances, or gambling;
c. all work that utilizes, provides or involves children for the production and trade of alcoholic beverages, narcotics, psychotropics, and other addictive substances; and/or
d. all work that endangers the health, safety or morals of children.

1. Pembinaan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak dilakukan oleh Pemerintah Daerah.

a. memberikan pelatihan bagi aparat pemerintah dan penegak  hukum tentang pencegahan;

c. memberikan pelatihan kepada tenaga kesehatan yang  memberikan pelayanan kesehatan kepada perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan di puskesmas, unit pelayanan  terpadu dan rumah sakit umum;
d. memberikan pelatihan kepada petugas rehabilitasi sosial dan  petugas bimbingan rohani dalam rangka melindungi  perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan; dan
e. melakukan peningkatan profesional petugas, pengelola data  kasus kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak di  puskesmas, unit pelayanan terpadu dan rumah sakit.
3. Bupati berwenang melakukan pembinaan dalam penyelengaraan  pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak.
translated_text:
CHAPTER X

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 76

1. Guidance on women's empowerment and child protection is carried out by the Regional Government.
2. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out in the form of:
a. providing training for government officials and law enforcement regarding prevention;
b. providing training for religious leaders, community leaders, traditional leaders, educators, journalists and media managers in order to prevent violence against women and children;
c. providing training to health workers who provide health services to women and children victims of violence at community health centers, integrated service units and general hospitals;
d. providing training to social rehabilitation officers and spiritual guidance officers in order to protect women and children victims of violence; and
e. conducting professional improvement for officers, data managers of violence cases against women and children at community health centers, integrated service units and hospitals.
3. The Regent has the authority to conduct guidance in the implementation of women's empowerment and child protection.

2. In conducting supervision and evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regent may appoint Regional Apparatus in accordance with their duties and functions.

Huruf f
Yang dimaksud dengan menghargai perbedaan  individu (individual differences) adalah setiap individu harus dipandang unik, masing-masing  orang mempunyai latar belakang, pengalaman hidup  dan cara menghadapi stress (Coping mechanism)  yang berbeda sehingga sehingga tidak boleh  dibandingkan antara satu korban dengan korban  lain dalam hal apapun.

Hurup h

Huruf i

What is meant by Gender Responsive is that all service officers must be gender sensitive when exploring the problems experienced by victims and can empower victims.

Point b
Sufficiently clear.

Point c
What is meant by equal and respectful relationships is that whoever the victim is, the provision of services for victims must be carried out with respect for the victim without distinguishing beliefs, values and social status.

Point d
What is meant by maintaining confidentiality is that services must be provided in a place that guarantees the victim's privacy. Every piece of information revealed in the service delivery process must be kept confidential and known only to people who are relevant in providing services. Officers must convey this principle to victims.

Point e
What is meant by providing a sense of security and comfort is that service officers must ensure that victims are in a safe and comfortable state in telling their problems.

Point f
What is meant by respecting individual differences is that each individual must be viewed as unique, each person has a different background, life experience and way of dealing with stress (Coping mechanism) so that one victim should not be compared with another victim in any respect.

Point g
What is meant by non-judgmental is that service officers must ensure that whatever the victim's condition, they will not be judged or condemned.

Point h
What is meant by respecting the victim's choices and decisions is that service provision must be done with the victim's consent, starting from the victim will not be judged or condemned.

Point i
What is meant by being sensitive to the victim's background and condition and using language that is appropriate and understood by the victim is that sometimes victims come from regions or economic, educational and environmental backgrounds that are not the same as the officers, it must be ensured that victims are served in language understood by the victim. Recently, more and more disabled/difable/disable women have become victims of violence, whether deaf, mute, blind or mentally retarded. For this category of victims, interpreters must also be provided, for example from special school teachers.

Point j
What is meant by fast and simple is that service provision must be given immediately without delay involving various parties, but with proactive service officers, victims must be guaranteed to go through everything with a simple process. If the victim comes on referral from another service provider, the receiving officer must first read the referral letter and efforts must be made so that the victim is not asked repeatedly about the same thing related to identity or case narrative.

Point k
What is meant by empathy, namely the ability to put oneself in the position of others (in this case the victim). Thus the victim feels accepted, understood and can openly tell their problems Point l What is meant by the fulfillment of women's and children's rights is that victims are entitled to respect and full use of their rights to survive, development, protection, freedom from all forms of discrimination and participation.

As stipulated in the Convention on the Rights of the Child and the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women.
